criterion: Relative L2 distance between the constructed common impulse on the two final grids must be strictly below the limit, in every flow/layout of the regime.
basis: Same 2% relative field-agreement limit already declared for fluid responses; adds a stricter treatment-convergence check, never relaxes any numerical threshold.
scope: The identical impulse is shared within each comparison, but its construction depends on the starting fields and can vary across grids. Fluid-response agreement alone does not establish convergence of this intervention. Applies to final common-probe claims and forcing-off common controls; original baseline analysis remains preserved.
